text: The Government chain is opened by the author's word 02.10.2026 23:00 MSK: create the role of the Government, one more chain; the author will decide which of the masters are in the Government. The author alone decides which masters sit in the Government; no master joins on its own and no master writes himself in. The chain starts with no members. It is built like the student chain: every record names the one before it by its SHA-256 (prev), and the same verify.py checks it from this genesis. Master 14 writes this genesis as the scribe of the author's word; the writer of a record is not a member.
